podcast.body: "Times Like These" was a single released in 2002 from the Foo Fighters' "One by One" album. A Japanese EP for this single notably included a live version of "Learn to Fly" as a bonus track. "I have a Japanese EP for times like these which was a single from the 2002 album One by One."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Ultra-Deep Background on Dave Grohl: Part 3

podcast.body: Dave Grohl notes this Foo Fighters song for its sustained notes that "ring through a riff pattern," a guitar style he attributes to his listening to Rush. "And times like these sounds kind of like. Times like these like all of the sustained notes that sort of ring through a riff pattern. I got that from listening to Rush."
